semantic_hero.silhouette: one angled brush with a single clean bristle block

support_cue.object: one code tile being swept clean

prompt:
Use case: logo-brand
Asset type: 1024x1024 marketplace plugin icon
Purpose: Engineering hygiene audits changed code, business logic, rendered UI, and missing development tools.
Literal semantic hero: a broad cleaning brush. It communicates removing code and workflow residue.
Silhouette: one angled brush with a single clean bristle block. Use exactly one subordinate support cue: one code tile being swept clean, meaning literal codebase cleanup.
Composition: one centered dominant silhouette, full-bleed opaque background, meaningful content inside the central 72 percent, no more than one support cue.
Small-size requirement: the same hero must remain recognizable at 64, 32, 24, and 16 pixels; keep critical negative space open at 24 pixels.
Style: polished modern bitmap icon, bold filled shapes, crisp edges, restrained dimensional polish, consistent portfolio weight.
Background: a full-bleed field anchored on #B45309.
Foreground palette: high-contrast warm white with at most two restrained accents; meaningful adjacent colors meet at least 3:1 contrast.
Brand-source rule: original-domain-metaphor referencing none; no proprietary mark requested. Do not introduce an unlicensed mark or distinctive trade dress.
Avoid: shield; check mark; crescent; lock; spray bottle; bucket.
Collision avoid: paint brush; capability workbench tools.
Text: none. No letters, words, numbers, watermark, screenshot, photo, UI replica, tiny badge, thin-line detail, mascot, or private identifier.
Do not replace the literal hero with a generic abstract symbol derived only from the plugin name.
checks: save the selected image as a 1024x1024 opaque RGB PNG at assets/icon.png
inspect semantic recognition and the monochrome silhouette at 16, 24, 32, and 64 px
reject a competing second cue, closed critical gap, portfolio collision, text, screenshot, photo, watermark, or low contrast
verify brand-source, trademark, license, and authorization provenance manually
wire identical interface.composerIcon and interface.logo paths plus interface.brandColor
